_doc: The opening cinematic, played after New Game once the lead is picked (src/ui/opening.gd, docs/25). Each shot is one picture, drawn in code, with its lines of narration shown one after another. `shot` picks the picture; `time` is how long the shot holds, in seconds, shared out evenly between its lines. Click, Space or Enter moves to the next shot; Esc skips the rest. Rewrite the words freely; a new kind of picture needs code.
_doc_cast: Who appears. `sixteen` are folders in art/sixteen/ (idle/south.png), in the order they stand in the ring; `lead` stands in for the lead who falls when none was picked (the lead picked is the one shown); `party` and `foe` are unit templates in units.json.

lines: Before the worlds, there was a contest.
Sixteen were chosen for it. Half-gods, each the best there ever was at something.
A shield-bearer, a hunter, a keeper of fires, a duelist who never lost.
Sixteen of them, and each would be given a world.
Sixteen copies of one Earth were made. In the middle of every one, a Tower.
Only one of the sixteen worlds will still be there at the end.
Then they were thrown down.
They fell for a long time, and as they fell, they forgot.
One of them is you.
You wake at the end of a furrow of burnt ground, with your name and nothing else.
Over everything, the Tower stands. A hundred floors, and something at the top.
Every chapter you climb gives back a little of who you were.
The world will not wait for you.
Towns trade and quarrel. A gate left alone breaks open. Miss a deadline and someone dies, or someone else is paid.
The roads are long. A few silver buys a seat on a carriage, part of the way.
The road has its own ideas about how far you get.
You will not climb it alone. Up to six will walk with you.
Not all of them will walk back. Here, the dead stay dead.
When it comes to blades, nobody waits their turn.
Stop the world, look, and choose. Then let it run.
Leave something alive, and it may remember you.
It may come back wearing the scar you gave it.
If you fall, your world ends with you.
You go on as one of the others, in their world, from the beginning.
Your weapon falls after you, somewhere. Your ghost waits at the fire.
A new standing quest: Ascend to heaven.
